responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s supergraph abstraction that combines GCC CFG basic blocks and callgraph relationships into one digraph. It defines the supergraph node/edge family, edge-kind taxonomy, statement and cgraph-edge lookup tables, saved_uids support, call/return/cfg/switch edge subclasses with callsite-expression mapping helpers, and dot-annotation hooks used by the engine, state propagation, and visualization code.
same_name_distinction: Defines the supergraph abstraction’s node, edge, traits, flags, and lookup interfaces—including call/cfg/switch edge classes and saved_uids—whereas supergraph.cc constructs the graph instances and implements their interprocedural and dumping behavior.
